name: EvidInvest
description: AI-powered financial data and portfolio analysis. Access DCF valuations, MPT optimization, earnings data, and more for any stock.

prompts.name: evaluate-stock
prompts.description: Full fundamental evaluation of a stock
prompts.template: Evaluate {{symbol}} as an investment. Get DCF fair value, PEG ratio, revenue CAGR, and fair value range. Is it undervalued or overvalued? Give a buy/hold/sell recommendation.

prompts.name: optimize-portfolio
prompts.template: Optimize this portfolio using MPT Max Sharpe: {{symbols}}. Show optimal weights, expected Sharpe ratio, and which stocks the optimizer excludes.

prompts.name: pre-earnings-research
prompts.template: {{symbol}} reports earnings soon. Get consensus estimates, our DCF fair value, PE vs historical average, and fair value range. What needs to happen for the stock to be fairly valued?

prompts.name: portfolio-self-evaluation
prompts.description: Evaluate current portfolio vs MPT optimal
prompts.template: Evaluate my portfolio: {{holdings}}. For each position get fair value and margin of safety. Then run MPT optimization and show how my allocation compares to the optimal weights.

prompts.name: portfolio-tracking
prompts.description: Create a portfolio list, add stocks, optimize, and track
prompts.template: Create a portfolio list called '{{name}}' with these stocks: {{symbols}}. Then run MPT optimization on them and show me the optimal weights. Finally, compare fair value for each position to find rebalance candidates.
